about_the_game:
Get ready for an explosive blend of moonshine, espionage, and tropical chaos — now with CO-OP!

In MULERUN, you’re not just any outlaw. You’re a legendary moonshiner caught by the CIA and faced with a choice: rot in prison for 15 years… or run risky missions for the government while building your own black market booze empire.

🌴 From brewing shady cocktails in your jungle shack to flying covert ops over cartel territory, every day brings new challenges, new risks, and new rewards.

🎮 KEY FEATURES

💥 Story-Driven Gameplay

  • Start from the bottom in a rundown house with just a pot and some fruit.

  • Get recruited by the CIA, infiltrate drug territories, photograph military zones, and smuggle sensitive intel... or cargo.

  • Communicate via pager, make shady deals in the night, and receive cryptic messages in highlighted newspapers.

👨‍🌾 Brew It or Lose It

  • Craft your own alcoholic drinks using real-time fermentation and distillation systems.

  • Collect exotic ingredients like coconuts and rotten pineapples from the streets.

  • Sell your booze to locals, at bars, or fulfill larger orders — but watch out for the cops and punk robbers!

🧪 Crafting System

  • Start with basic distilling equipment and work your way up.

  • Collect recipes, automate production, and unlock higher-quality brews.

  • Bottle, cap, and crate your goods by hand — or eventually, scale up with new gear.

✈️ Flight Missions & Espionage

  • Receive covert missions from the CIA and cartels alike.

  • Fly under radar, dodge patrols, avoid detection, and photograph critical targets.

  • Deliver secret cargo or smuggle contraband across the border — complete with realistic risk mechanics like load weight and cleaning chemical residue.

🗺️ Open World with Time Cycle

  • Explore the tropics on foot or in your pickup.

  • Discover secrets, engage with NPCs, gamble at arcades, and survive the nightlife.

  • A full day/night cycle affects what’s available and who you can meet.

👥 CO-OP MODE

  • Team up with friends to distill faster, transport bigger loads, and pull off wild missions together. Split the profits — or double-cross them.

📈 Progression & Customization

  • Level up from a broke bootlegger to a master distiller.

  • Unlock skills, gear, and hilarious titles along the way.

  • Fully customize your character's appearance — from skin tone to belt buckle.

🎲 Mini-Games & Side Hustles

  • Play arcade machines, dice games, and street hustles.

  • Interact with quirky characters, unlock side quests, and keep your operation running under the radar.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Start solo or in online co-op, with each player taking on different roles: brew master, getaway driver, shady negotiator, or air support pilot. You’ll need to cooperate (or yell at each other) as you dodge cops, complete ridiculous tasks, and climb the ranks of two very dangerous worlds...
